evals.prompt: I want to add a feature that lets event-type owners set a custom "thank you" message that shows on the booking confirmation page after someone books. Can you build this?
evals.expected_output: Claude runs a specification interview first, then writes a technical plan to docs/plans/ following the template (Summary, Goals, Non-goals, Affected areas, Data model, API/server, UI, Gating, i18n, Edge cases, Testing strategy, Implementation steps) and pauses for the user's approval before writing any code. It does not jump straight into editing source files.

evals.prompt: We need to let team admins bulk-export their team's bookings as a CSV from the bookings page. Walk me through developing this.
evals.expected_output: Claude asks scoping questions (which columns, date range, permissions, large-dataset handling), produces a docs/plans/*.md plan with a real implementation-steps section naming files/procedures, and stops for approval. If it proceeds past approval it adds Vitest tests, runs scoped type-check/lint/build/tests and reports the results as a table, then drafts a PR description based on .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md into docs/plans/*-pr.md.

evals.prompt: Add a user setting so people can choose whether cancelled bookings still show up in their calendar view or get hidden. Develop the whole thing.
evals.expected_output: Claude interviews for the spec (default value, per-user vs per-calendar, migration of existing users), writes the plan to docs/plans/ with the data-model section addressing the new setting/column and migration, and waits for approval. The final PR description follows the repo template including the Mandatory Tasks checkboxes and a filled-in "How should this be tested?" section.
